svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Purser architecture: four layers
svg.desc: Four stacked layers. 1, CFO and company: the CFO's passkey (WebAuthn, signs the SHA-256 of the exact terms), /try, Purser Cloud and /verify. 2, Purser engine: Claude agents (Reader on Sonnet, Checker on Haiku, Sourcing on Haiku, Support on Sonnet, Treasury on Opus) and the negotiation propose; the CFO policy, the terms hash with approvals and the hash-chained audit log decide in code; a changed cent is refused because the signature no longer matches. 3, Payment rails, test money only: Airwallex sandbox (cards with the CFO's limits as card controls, transfers carrying the signed hash, FX), Alta testnet (a mandate per agent with a cap, x402 payments), Visa Intelligent Commerce via Airwallex Airi (sandbox). 4, Proof: proof files, the T:0 read-back, verify-all and the audit log's head anchored on Alta.
svg.text: Purser: how one payment is decided
